Container.Name: brainnet-viewer-lan
Container.Overview: BrainNet Viewer displays brain surfaces, networks, volumetric maps and atlas regions in a browser. This LAN template uses HTTPS and a team access password, with a separate application process and workspace for each signed-in browser session. Prepare a trusted server certificate, its private key and a password file before installation. Save Scene downloads a portable ZIP; session uploads are temporary. Intended for trusted teams on a LAN. CPU rendering works without an allocated GPU; NVIDIA acceleration is optional.
Container.Requires: Read the installation guide before starting. Requires a trusted TLS certificate, a private key, a password file readable by UID 10001, and an explicit HTTPS server origin. Unraid hardware validation is pending; Docker runtime checks are documented separately.
Container.PostArgs: -c 'import os,sys; from brainnet_viewer.web_server import main; sys.argv=["brainnet-server","--host","0.0.0.0","--port","1031","--public-origin",os.environ["BNV_SERVER_ORIGIN"],"--password-file","/run/bnv-secrets/access_password.txt","--cert","/run/bnv-secrets/server.crt","--key","/run/bnv-secrets/server.key","--max-sessions",os.environ["BNV_MAX_SESSIONS"],"--idle-seconds",os.environ["BNV_IDLE_SECONDS"],"--worker-threads",os.environ["BNV_WORKER_THREADS"]]; main()'
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: brain neuroscience neuroimaging connectome MRI visualization LAN

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Host HTTPS port. Match this port in Public HTTPS origin.

Config.Name: Public HTTPS origin
Config.Description: Required: https://YOUR_UNRAID_IP:1031, without a path. Must match the certificate and browser address.

Config.Name: Private server files
Config.Description: Prepare server.crt, server.key and access_password.txt first. Mount read-only; files must be readable by UID 10001. Do not expose this directory through SMB/NFS.

Config.Name: Rendering backend
Config.Description: auto chooses an accessible GPU when a rendering probe succeeds, otherwise CPU. cpu forces CPU; gpu requires GPU. Device allocation is configured separately.

Config.Name: Maximum sessions
Config.Description: Maximum signed-in sessions (1-32). All share the container CPU/memory limits.

Config.Name: Idle timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Idle session lifetime (30-86400 seconds). Save Scene before expiry.

Config.Name: Worker threads
Config.Description: Scientific-library threads per worker (1-64); not a per-worker CPU quota.
